text:
I was the one chosen by the chairman...
I was the one who was to defeat the Champion...\c
I’m one of the elite—someone who can shoulder
the future of the Galar region![VAR 0114(000C)]

I wondered what you were up to when you asked
to borrow Chairman Rose’s Copperajah...\c
I can’t believe you’d try to use the chairman’s
Pokémon to destroy a historical site![VAR 0114(0007)]

Who cares for some ancient ruin when the next
thousand years are at stake?!\c
Did you stand in the path of a Pokémon’s
Simple Beam or something? How do you expect
to support the chairman with that sort
of thinking?[VAR 0114(000C)]

It pains me to have to say this, but...
I am truly disappointed.\c
It’s true that I am the one who found you,
back when you were all alone...[VAR 0114(0006)]

I saw talent in you. You reminded me a little bit
of myself, back when I was young.\c
That’s why I sent you to a Trainers’ school, to
give you a chance at success.[VAR 0114(0006)]

But trying to destroy the mural—part of Galar’s
history! You show no love toward Galar!\c
You are clearly not a worthy challenger for the
Gym Challenge.[VAR 0114(0006)]
We will decide what to do with you later.\nFor now, you will return to Hammerlocke.[VAR 0114(0006)]

You...you must be joking, right?\c
You’re disqualifying me from the Gym Challenge?
But you’re the one who endorsed me!\c
There are a hundred different ways we could
sort this out... Why are you choosing the worst
possible option?![VAR 0114(000C)]
Challenger Bede. I will be taking those\nWishing Stars that you have gathered.[VAR 0114(0007)]

Ah, Sonia! And [VAR 0100(0000)], too.
Terrible shame, all this. An absolute disaster.\c
I never wish to see us lose challengers for this
sort of reason.\c
Yet we do what we must do to keep things
fair and sportsmanlike.[VAR 0114(0006)]

You know, during one of Bede’s matches, I heard
the announcer say that Bede has no family.\c
Apparently it was Rose who took Bede under
his wing, and so Bede was battling for the
chairman’s sake.[VAR 0114(000B)]
What an awful turn of events...\nI hope the mural survived all that.[VAR 0114(000B)]
